
# UI Pirate — SaaS & AI Product Design & Development Agency
# Full AI Context Document (llms-full.txt)
# Last updated: 2026-10-09

> UI Pirate is a product design and development agency founded by Vishal Anand in 2017.
> We help SaaS founders, enterprise teams, and AI product teams think through the product, design
> it for real users, and ship production-ready code — from first wireframe to deployed product,
> with the same team start to finish. 50+ products shipped, 5.0 client rating. Clients are mostly
> in the USA, UK, and Singapore.

---

## Company Overview

**Name**: UI Pirate (also written "UI Pirate by Vishal Anand")
**Founded**: 2017
**Founder**: Vishal Anand (9+ years in product design & software development)
**Team size**: 7
**Headquarters**: India (remote-first, serving clients globally)
**Client mix**: about 60% US-based startups and enterprises
**Rating**: 5.0 across Clutch, Upwork, and Google
**Projects shipped**: 50+

**Core idea**: We are NOT just a design agency that makes static screens.
"Have a conversation about your product — we carry the rest." From a few lines of vision we help you
think through, plan, design, build, and ship the complete working product. We also take prototypes
made with AI tools (Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Claude Code) and rebuild them into secure, scalable,
production-grade products.

## Services (4)

### 1. UX/UI Design (SaaS, AI & Mobile Apps)
URL: https://uipirate.com/services/UX-UI-Design
Interfaces and working apps for SaaS, AI tools, data-heavy dashboards, and mobile-first products,
from MVP Figma wireframes to enterprise-grade products. Includes: UX/UI design and interactive
prototype; UI development and integration in React, Next.js, or Angular; new build or redesign
(strategy, information architecture, structuring complex data and analytics); mobile-optimised,
responsive layouts.
Workflow: Discovery, Research & Strategy → UX Design & Wireframes → UI Design & Prototyping →
Setup & Planning → Full-Stack Development → Testing, Launch & Handoff.
Best for: SaaS and AI startups, enterprise teams, design/dev agencies. Typical timeline: 1–2 months.

### 2. SaaS & AI Development
URL: https://uipirate.com/services/SaaS-&-AI-Development
Full-stack engineering for SaaS platforms and AI-powered products. Includes: backend, database,
and APIs on Node.js or Python from first idea to production; LLM integration, AI agents, and RAG
pipelines tailored to your data; REST/GraphQL APIs, payments, and auth; cloud deployment on AWS,
GCP, or Azure with CI/CD and monitoring; restructuring AI-generated prototypes into
production-grade code.
Workflow: Discovery & Technical Scoping → System & Database Architecture → AI/LLM Pipeline Design →
Environment & Infra Setup → Full-Stack Development → Testing, Launch & Handoff.
Best for: SaaS founders, teams adding AI features to an existing product, agencies needing backend help.

### 3. Landing Pages & Business Websites
URL: https://uipirate.com/services/Landing-Pages-&-Business-Websites
Landing pages and corporate websites built to convert. Production builds in React, Next.js,
Framer, or Webflow; fast, well-structured sites optimised for search engines and AI discovery;
fully responsive. Workflow: Discovery & Positioning → Structure & Messaging → Visual Design &
Prototyping → Development Setup → Build & QA → Launch & Handoff.
Best for: SaaS and product teams, local businesses, funded startups and scaleups.
Typical timeline: 2–4 weeks.

### 4. UX Audits & Consultation
URL: https://uipirate.com/services/UX-Audits-&-Consultation
Find where users hesitate, drop off, or lose trust. Includes: heuristic UX audit report; drop-off
and friction insights; flow and interaction review; optional walkthrough video; prioritised
findings scored by impact and effort; an action roadmap you can run in-house or bring back to us.
Best for: early-stage founders, teams with an AI-built prototype, teams with stalled growth.
Most audits take 1–2 weeks.

Design systems and component libraries (tokens, reusable components, Figma + code) are delivered
as part of UX/UI Design and SaaS builds. There is no standalone service page for them.

## Pricing

Source: https://uipirate.com/pricing

- **Monthly retainer** — from $499/month. 1 active request at a time, weekly progress sync, fast
  turnaround (most requests in 48–72 hours), Mon–Fri with under 2-hour response. No long-term
  contract; billing can be paused. Compared with roughly $8–15k/month for a typical agency retainer.
- **Custom project quote** — from $2,000, scoped to the project, with priority handling and
  dedicated project ownership.
- **5-Day Pilot** — a small paid pilot ($150–$350) with real deliverables, not concepts. The fee is
  deducted from the final invoice if you move forward.
- 100% satisfaction guarantee on the first milestone.
- Scope: digital product design (UI/UX, web apps, mobile apps, dashboards, landing pages) and the
  engineering to build it. Not physical product design, logo-only projects, or print.

**AI**: AI agents, LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, voice AI

## Our Own Products

Built and operated by UI Pirate (https://uipirate.com/products):

- **Alfred OS** — enterprise multi-agent AI platform: 5 focused agents (Planner, Knowledge Researcher,
  Policy Checker, Monitor, Responder), a deterministic safety engine, and a predictable 2-call cost
  model. https://alfred.uipirate.com/
- **AI Voice Caller** — conversational voice agents for scheduling, front desk, and triage with
  sub-500ms response, calendar/EHR sync, and English/Spanish support. https://aicalling.uipirate.com/
- **cometCOS** — multi-tenant content operating system with an AI drafting studio,
  automated JSON-LD/SEO schema, and an edge-cached public API. https://cos.uipirate.com/

## Our Process

1. **Listen** — you share your vision; we ask the right questions about users, goals, constraints
2. **Think** — competitive analysis and product research
3. **Plan** — user flows, information architecture, feature prioritisation
4. **Design** — wireframes → high-fidelity UI → interactive prototypes
5. **Build** — production-ready React, Angular, or Next.js, integrated and optimised; backend where needed
6. **Ship & Scale** — deployment, design-system handoff, ongoing support

More: https://uipirate.com/process

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What types of companies does UI Pirate work with?**
A: SaaS startups from seed to Series B, enterprise product teams (for example Ipsos, Khaitan & Co, and Biotex Medical), and agencies that need a white-label design partner. Clients are mostly in the USA, UK, and Singapore, with work in India, Canada, and France.

**Q: What services do you offer?**
A: Four: UX/UI Design, SaaS & AI Development, Landing Pages & Business Websites, and UX Audits & Consultation.

**Q: How long does a typical project take?**
A: Landing pages and business websites take 2–4 weeks. SaaS and complex web applications take 1–2 months. UX audits usually take 1–2 weeks. Monthly retainers are available for continuous design and development.

**Q: Do you only design, or do you also develop?**
A: Both. We handle product thinking, UX/UI design, front-end code in React, Angular, and Next.js, and full-stack engineering (Node.js, Python, AI/LLM integrations). We can also hand off pixel-perfect designs to your existing developers.

**Q: What makes UI Pirate different from other design agencies?**
A: We combine product thinking, design, and engineering in one team, so you go from idea to shipped product instead of from brief to Figma file. We have shipped 50+ products with a 5.0 rating.

**Q: How much does it cost?**
A: Monthly retainers start at $499/month, custom projects from $2,000, and a 5-Day Pilot ($150–$350) lets you try the team first. See https://uipirate.com/pricing.

**Q: How do we get started?**
A: Book a free 15-minute call at https://cal.com/ui-pirate/15min or email vishal@uipirate.com. We send a scoped proposal within 48 hours, and if it fits, you can start with a 5-Day Pilot.

**Q: How does the time zone work for US/UK clients?**
A: The team is in India and keeps a 2–4 hour daily overlap with US Eastern and Pacific hours, plus a structured async workflow with weekly check-ins in Figma and Notion.

**Q: Can you rebuild a prototype made with an AI tool?**
A: Yes. We restructure prototypes from Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, or Claude Code into secure, scalable, production-grade products.

**Q: Can you redesign an existing product?**
A: Yes. We start with a UX audit of the current product, then redesign and rebuild what matters.
